enforced_by_lean_child: OS sandbox denies all filesystem writes
120-second subprocess wall timeout with process-group kill
enforced_by_verifier: Frozen common file SHA256 checks before every verification
Exact original declaration replaced once in full source context
Candidate lexical rejection for sorry, admit, axioms, resource overrides and specified evaluator escapes
Target transitive axioms must be a subset of propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
Lean exit success and absence of errors required
Immutable unique run labels; attempts are never overwritten
instruction_only_for_coding_agents: Write only the assigned arm directory
Do not inspect other arms or earlier optimized solutions
No package installation, builds, web access or external model calls
Same task ordering and common deadline
not_enforced_or_observable: Coding agent filesystem/network access is not OS sandboxed
Exact inherited model identifier is not exposed by spawn result
Model token use, backend sampling and billed cost are unavailable
No process CPU affinity or host-wide load isolation
No repeated independent model generations under identical effort
Prompt and decision history are saved but internal model request/response traces are not exposed
Operating-system filesystem page cache is not reset between runs
Equal wall budget does not imply equal model token or inference compute budget
Occasional parent control probes overlap the early parallel runs; wall time is descriptive only
